verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents instant rollback to a previous agent deployment, which implies deployments are kept as versions. The only evidence is a single pricing-page line. Explicit deployment versioning and a review or diff workflow for changes are not documented; agents being Python/Node code a user could keep in git is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented deployment version history, a review or approval workflow for changes, depth on how rollback works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Instant rollback to a previous agent deployment
